paragraphs.text: The Junior Backend Developer position in Barcelona aligns directly with my background in computer engineering and my focus on backend development.

In my backend projects, I have developed applications in Python using FastAPI to build REST services. This includes building a network monitoring backend that serves device status to a dashboard, as well as an automated Python scraper that processes flight pricing data.

Additionally, during my internship at Example Consulting, I validated data using SQL queries and triaged defects within an Agile banking project. These experiences have given me practical knowledge of backend workflows, database querying, and collaborative development.
